table.retrieve:
SELECT  	 
	saleorderheader.saleordercode , 
	saleinvcode = (SELECT AssociatedSaleInvCode FROM PurLedger PL WHERE PL.AssociatedSaleOrderCode=saleorderheader.saleordercode),
	saleorderheader.date , 
	saleorderheader.billingdate,
	saleorderheader.custrefno , 
	saleorderheader.remarks , 
	saleorderheader.custcode , 
	saleorderheader.usercode ,
	saleorderheader.headerno,  
	users.username , 
	saleorderheader.discperc , 
	saleorderheader.flatdisc , 
	saleorderheader.misccharges , 
	saleorderheader.posted , 
	saleorderheader.postdate , 
	customer.address1 , 
	customer.city, 
	customer.phone ,
	customerbalance = 0,
	debitorcredit = ' ',
	aliasname=accounts.aliasname,
	saleorderheader.headerinvno,
	saleorderheader.originaldate,
	saleorderheader.modifiedby,
	saleorderheader.sprice,
	saleorderheader.quotationcode,
	saleorderheader.postedby,
	saleorderheader.doctcode,
	patientRegNo='          ',
	saleorderheader.patientcode,
	invGSTPerc1=saleorderheader.InvGstPerc1,
	dd_gstperc=0,
	gcode=0,
	saleorderheader.gstno,
	saleorderheader.MessageCode,
	Message.Description,
	saleorderheader.SmanCode,
	Salesman.Name,
	saleorderheader.custrefno2,
	saleorderheader.custrefno3,
	saleorderheader.custrefno4,
	saleorderheader.InvoiceSize,
	saleorderheader.invtotal,
	saleorderheader.machinename,
	saleorderheader.ModifyCounter,
	saleorderheader.wardcode,
	saleorderheader.diseasecode,
	saleorderheader.relationcode,
	saleorderheader.itemdiscpercno,
	saleorderheader.PaymentMode,
	saleorderheader.PaymentAccCode,
	saleorderheader.Amt,
	saleorderheader.AmtBy,
	saleorderheader.AmtDate,
	saleorderheader.AmtReference,
	saleorderheader.deliveredby,
	saleorderheader.pptcustcode,
	saleorderheader.deleted,
	saleorderheader.finalized,
	saleorderheader.prescode,
	saleorderheader.SuppInvCode,
	saleorderheader.GRN,
	saleorderheader.GCCode,
	saleorderheader.Vehicle,
	saleorderheader.ShipTo,
	AssociatedPurInvCode = (SELECT MAX(PL.PurInvCode) FROM PurLedger PL WHERE PL.AssociatedSaleOrderCode = :ar_saleordercode)
FROM  
	customer , 
	saleorderheader 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN salesman ON (saleorderheader.smancode = salesman.salesmancode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN message ON ( saleorderheader.messagecode = message.messagecode),
	users , 
	accounts  
WHERE 
	dbo.saleorderheader.saleordercode = :ar_saleordercode AND
	saleorderheader.custcode = customer.custcode and 
	saleorderheader.custcode = accounts.acccode and 
	users.usercode = saleorderheader.usercode
